# HSC — Wyatt's Notes

> Free, open-access study notes. Part of the Wyatt's Notes network at https://wyattsnotes.wyattau.com

HSC revision notes covering core subjects with detailed explanations, worked examples, practice problems, and flashcards.

All pages are open-access, ad-free, and licensed under AGPLv3.

## Overview

- [About This Site](https://hsc.wyattau.com/about/): About Wyatt's Notes HSC resources, experience, expertise, and credentials behind Australian Higher School Certificate study materials.
- [Complete HSC Study Guide, Physics and Maths](https://hsc.wyattau.com/hub/): Study notes for Complete HSC Study Guide, Physics and Maths with worked examples, practice problems, and key concepts for exam preparation.
- [HSC - Wyatt's Notes](https://hsc.wyattau.com/): HSC revision notes covering core subjects with detailed explanations, worked examples, practice problems, and flashcards.
- [HSC Exam Glossary, Key Terms](https://hsc.wyattau.com/glossary/): Comprehensive glossary of HSC Exam terms covering the NSW education system, assessment, ATAR, scaling, and university admissions.
- [HSC Physics Flashcards](https://hsc.wyattau.com/flashcards-physics/): QUALIFICATIONS Hsc flashcards: HSC Physics Flashcards. Comprehensive study material with definitions, examples, and assessment tools.
- [Introduction to HSC/VCE Notes](https://hsc.wyattau.com/intro/): The and the are the two major school-leaving qualifications in Australia. They are awarded upon completion of senior secondary schooling and are the primary
- [Mathematics Practice](https://hsc.wyattau.com/practice-mathematics/): 15 MCQ questions covering algebra, calculus, trigonometry, probability, and statistics. Select an option to check your answer and view the explanation.
- [Physics Practice](https://hsc.wyattau.com/practice-physics/): 15 MCQ questions covering mechanics, electricity, waves, nuclear physics, and thermal physics. Select an option to check your answer and view the explanation.
